[[Nicholas the Traveler]] }} A [[Celestial Essence]] is all that remains of a fallen [[celestial]]. {{TOCright}} ==Acquisition== * [[Factions]] ** [[Nahpui Quarter]] mission *** [[Hai Jii]] *** [[Kaijun Don]] *** [[Kuonghsang]] *** [[Tahmu]] *** [[Essence of Dragon]] *** [[Essence of Kirin]] *** [[Essence of Phoenix]] *** [[Essence of Turtle]] {{ongoing item research}} ===Farming=== [[File:Nahpui-Mission-Essence.jpg|thumb|right|Farming Celestial Essences in [[Nahpui Quarter]]]] In order for them to [[spawn]], you must first eliminate their respective bosses. Killing [[Kaijun Don]], the Kirin celestial, will cause Essences of Kirin to spawn, and so on. Bear in mind that, after a short period of time, essences will respawn upon returning to their original locations. These, in turn, will not drop loot, which makes backtracking less attractive for farming. Proceed with the mission as normal, leaving the last boss alive to prevent completion. It is recommended to start with the left-most portal and leaving [[Hai Jii]] alive as [[Essence of Phoenix|Essences of Phoenix]] will consistently interrupt your skills. When fighting [[Kuonghsang]] or [[Essence of Turtle]], consider moving out of aggro range to prevent being the target of [[Grenth's Balance]] once they are low on health. Consider also venturing outside the path shown to eliminate additional groups of Celestials. One method is to bring a [[Soloing|solo]] farming build and a [[party]] of [[Henchman|henchmen]] and/or [[hero]]es. Have them help kill all the [[Tengu]], but avoid killing any of the bosses. Once the map is cleared of Tengu, [[Hero flag|flag]] your party away and solo farm the Celestials. Essences of Phoenix can be solo farmed by a [[spirit spammer]], since they rely on [[hex spell]]s to deal damage and [[spirit]]s cannot be hexed. [[Essence of Dragon|Essences of Dragon]] and Essences of Turtle can be solo farmed using [[spell targeting prevention]] skills, since they only use [[spell]]s. ==Collectors== {{:Sakai/Collector}} {{:Nicholas the Traveler/Collector|5th September 2011 and 8th October 2012|Nahpui Quarter (explorable area)|3 [[Celestial Essence]]s}} ==Notes== * This item is required by [[Imperial Chef Reun]] for his salad at the annual [[Canthan New Year]] festival. *The collector [[Sakai]] trades 5 Celestial Essences for items that sell for 125 {{gold}} each to a merchant. This provides 25% more gold than selling the trophies directly to a merchant. [[Category:Profitable trophies]] [[Category:Items requested during Canthan New Year]]
